transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?
I came in because when I start eating alone at night, it feels like something takes over. I keep telling myself to stop or put the food away, but I just… can’t seem to stop.
During these times, do you eat an unusually large amount of food?

Yeah. After a late shift, I can eat a whole frozen pizza, then cereal right out of the box, leftovers, snacks—whatever's in the cabinet—within an hour or two. It's way more than I would ever eat around anyone else.
After these episodes, do you ever make yourself vomit?
Yeah. Afterward I usually go to the bathroom and make myself throw up. It feels like the only way to undo it before the calories settle in.
How much does your body shape or weight affect how you feel about yourself?

A lot, honestly. When I look in the bathroom mirror, I just focus on my stomach and waist. If they don’t look right, I feel like I’ve failed at being disciplined, even if I had a good day at the rescue center.
